fusions.name: Breaching Surge
fusions.desc: Rolls a surge of water that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Drifting Wake
fusions.desc: Pushes a wake out around you; each hit deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 50% chance of leaving the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Calm Waters
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Rising Tide
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, the healing you receive is 40% stronger for 8 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
